info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-Delete Streaming Subscriptions Cancel-v2-spec
info.description: The Streaming Subscriptions Cancellation API allows businesses to efficiently manage and cancel active subscriptions in their streaming services. This endpoint is essential for users needing to halt ongoing subscriptions, thereby facilitating easier account management and customer satisfaction. Typically utilized by customer support teams and account management applications, it enables quick and effective handling of subscription cancellations. Leverage this API to streamline subscription operations and enhance user experiences.

delete.description: Use this endpoint to cancel an existing subscription. This action will terminate the subscription and prevent any further billing or services associated with it.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the necessary parameters for cancelling a subscription. Ensure that all required fields are accurately filled to process the cancellation effectively.

DeleteStreamingSubscriptionsCancelReques.description: The request body for cancelling a subscription operation. It contains the necessary information to identify the subscription to be cancelled.

status.description: Indicates the success or failure of the cancellation operation.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number associated with the cancellation request.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the cancellation operation.

state.description: The current state of the subscription after the cancellation operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the cancellation request, measured in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the cancellation operation.

DeleteStreamingSubscriptionsCancelRespon.description: Response schema for a successful subscription cancellation operation.

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the cancellation request.

createdAt.description: The timestamp of when the cancellation request was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the cancellation request was created by an automated process.

AuditInfo.description: Information related to the audit of the cancellation operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time taken by the server to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
